1.web: Dinah, the daughter of Leah, whom she bore to Jacob, went out to see the daughters of the land.
1.asv: And Dinah the daughter of Leah, whom she bare unto Jacob, went out to see the daughters of the land.

2.web: Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, the prince of the land, saw her. He took her, lay with her, and humbled her.
2.asv: And Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, the prince of the land, saw her; and he took her, and lay with her, and humbled her.

3.web: His soul joined to Dinah, the daughter of Jacob, and he loved the young lady, and spoke kindly to the young lady.
3.asv: And his soul clave unto Dinah the daughter of Jacob, and he loved the damsel, and spake kindly unto the damsel.

4.web: Shechem spoke to his father, Hamor, saying, “Get me this young lady as a wife.”
4.asv: And Shechem spake unto his father Hamor, saying, Get me this damsel to wife.

5.web: Now Jacob heard that he had defiled Dinah, his daughter; and his sons were with his livestock in the field. Jacob held his peace until they came.
5.asv: Now Jacob heard that he had defiled Dinah his daughter; and his sons were with his cattle in the field: and Jacob held his peace until they came.

6.web: Hamor the father of Shechem went out to Jacob to talk with him.
6.asv: And Hamor the father of Shechem went out unto Jacob to commune with him.

7.web: The sons of Jacob came in from the field when they heard it. The men were grieved, and they were very angry, because he had done folly in Israel in lying with Jacob’s daughter; a thing ought not to be done.
7.asv: And the sons of Jacob came in from the field when they heard it: and the men were grieved, and they were very wroth, because he had wrought folly in Israel in lying with Jacob’s daughter; which thing ought not to be done.

8.web: Hamor talked with them, saying, “The soul of my son, Shechem, longs for your daughter. Please give her to him as a wife.
8.asv: And Hamor communed with them, saying, The soul of my son Shechem longeth for your daughter: I pray you, give her unto him to wife.

9.web: Make marriages with us. Give your daughters to us, and take our daughters for yourselves.
9.asv: And make ye marriages with us; give your daughters unto us, and take our daughters unto you.

10.web: You shall dwell with us, and the land will be before you. Live and trade in it, and get possessions in it.”
10.asv: And ye shall dwell with us: and the land shall be before you; dwell and trade ye therein, and get you possessions therein.

11.web: Shechem said to her father and to her brothers, “Let me find favor in your eyes, and whatever you will tell me I will give.
11.asv: And Shechem said unto her father and unto her brethren, Let me find favor in your eyes, and what ye shall say unto me I will give.

12.web: Ask me a great amount for a dowry, and I will give whatever you ask of me, but give me the young lady as a wife.”
12.asv: Ask me never so much dowry and gift, and I will give according as ye shall say unto me: but give me the damsel to wife.

13.web: The sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father with deceit, and spoke, because he had defiled Dinah their sister,
13.asv: And the sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father with guile, and spake, because he had defiled Dinah their sister,

14.web: and said to them, “We can’t do this thing, to give our sister to one who is uncircumcised; for that is a reproach to us.
14.asv: and said unto them, We cannot do this thing, to give our sister to one that is uncircumcised; for that were a reproach unto us.

15.web: Only on this condition will we consent to you. If you will be as we are, that every male of you be circumcised;
15.asv: Only on this condition will we consent unto you: if ye will be as we are, that every male of you be circumcised;

16.web: then will we give our daughters to you, and we will take your daughters to us, and we will dwell with you, and we will become one people.
16.asv: then will we give our daughters unto you, and we will take your daughters to us, and we will dwell with you, and we will become one people.

17.web: But if you will not listen to us, to be circumcised, then we will take our sister, and we will be gone.”
17.asv: But if ye will not hearken unto us, to be circumcised; then will we take our daughter, and we will be gone.

18.web: Their words pleased Hamor and Shechem, Hamor’s son.
18.asv: And their words pleased Hamor, and Shechem Hamor’s son.

19.web: The young man didn’t wait to do this thing, because he had delight in Jacob’s daughter, and he was honored above all the house of his father.
19.asv: And the young man deferred not to do the thing, because he had delight in Jacob’s daughter: and he was honored above all the house of his father.

20.web: Hamor and Shechem, his son, came to the gate of their city, and talked with the men of their city, saying,
20.asv: And Hamor and Shechem his son came unto the gate of their city, and communed with the men of their city, saying,

21.web: “These men are peaceful with us. Therefore let them live in the land and trade in it. For behold, the land is large enough for them. Let us take their daughters to us for wives, and let us give them our daughters.
21.asv: These men are peaceable with us; therefore let them dwell in the land, and trade therein; for, behold, the land is large enough for them; let us take their daughters to us for wives, and let us give them our daughters.

22.web: Only on this condition will the men consent to us to live with us, to become one people, if every male among us is circumcised, as they are circumcised.
22.asv: Only on this condition will the men consent unto us to dwell with us, to become one people, if every male among us be circumcised, as they are circumcised.

23.web: Won’t their livestock and their possessions and all their animals be ours? Only let us give our consent to them, and they will dwell with us.”
23.asv: Shall not their cattle and their substance and all their beasts be ours? only let us consent unto them, and they will dwell with us.

24.web: All who went out of the gate of his city listened to Hamor, and to Shechem his son; and every male was circumcised, all who went out of the gate of his city.
24.asv: And unto Hamor and unto Shechem his son hearkened all that went out of the gate of his city; and every male was circumcised, all that went out of the gate of his city.

25.web: On the third day, when they were sore, two of Jacob’s sons, Simeon and Levi, Dinah’s brothers, each took his sword, came upon the unsuspecting city, and killed all the males.
25.asv: And it came to pass on the third day, when they were sore, that two of the sons of Jacob, Simeon and Levi, Dinah’s brethren, took each man his sword, and came upon the city unawares, and slew all the males.

26.web: They killed Hamor and Shechem, his son, with the edge of the sword, and took Dinah out of Shechem’s house, and went away.
26.asv: And they slew Hamor and Shechem his son with the edge of the sword, and took Dinah out of Shechem’s house, and went forth.

27.web: Jacob’s sons came on the dead, and plundered the city, because they had defiled their sister.
27.asv: The sons of Jacob came upon the slain, and plundered the city, because they had defiled their sister.

28.web: They took their flocks, their herds, their donkeys, that which was in the city, that which was in the field,
28.asv: They took their flocks and their herds and their asses, and that which was in the city, and that which was in the field;

29.web: and all their wealth. They took captive all their little ones and their wives, and took as plunder everything that was in the house.
29.asv: and all their wealth, and all their little ones and their wives, took they captive and made a prey, even all that was in the house.

30.web: Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, “You have troubled me, to make me odious to the inhabitants of the land, among the Canaanites and the Perizzites. I am few in number. They will gather themselves together against me and strike me, and I will be destroyed, I and my house.”
30.asv: And Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, Ye have troubled me, to make me odious to the inhabitants of the land, among the Canaanites and the Perizzites: and, I being few in number, they will gather themselves together against me and smite me; and I shall be destroyed, I and my house.

31.web: They said, “Should he deal with our sister as with a prostitute?”
31.asv: And they said, Should he deal with our sister as with a harlot?
